display.purpose: Wordmark, page headlines, tile titles only.

body.purpose: Everything functional: forms, rows, nav, copy.

label.purpose: Uppercase field labels and small kickers.

shadows.name: elevation-1
shadows.purpose: Lightest lift off the surface below.

shadows.name: elevation-5
shadows.purpose: The deepest lift in the scale.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Purple selected/focused-state glow, paired with accent-edge.

shadows.name: accent-glow-gold
shadows.purpose: Gold variant of the selected/focused glow.

shadows.name: button-primary-glow
shadows.purpose: The primary gold button's signature colored shadow + bevel highlight.

motion.name: ease-decelerate
motion.purpose: Default easing for anything that arrives and stops.

motion.name: ease-overshoot
motion.purpose: Physical motion — a toggle thumb, a settling tile.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single saturated action per screen — sign-in submit, mobile lobby's primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: #1c1305; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(152deg, #ffe08f 0%, #ffe98a 38%, #ffd23f 74%, #a8760c 100%); box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(255, 210, 63, .3), inset 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .45); transition: filter .12s ease, transform .12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #150a2b, 0 0 0 4px #ffe98a; }

components.name: Secondary Button (OAuth)
components.description: One step quieter than primary — Google sign-in, secondary chrome actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: #e9eef6; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; background: rgba(182, 166, 219, .085); transition: background .15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(182, 166, 219, .13); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #150a2b, 0 0 0 4px #ffe98a; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent at rest — guest entry, tertiary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: #9fadc5; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; transition: background .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #edf1f7; background: rgba(182, 166, 219, .055); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Filled surface, no border — the chrome's borderless-by-default field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; text-align: left; } .ds-field > span { color: #96a3ba; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .15em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 15px; color: #eef2f8; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; outline: 0; background: rgba(182, 166, 219, .055); font-size: 16px; transition: background .22s ease, box-shadow .22s ease; } .ds-field input:focus { background: rgba(182, 166, 219, .085); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(155, 63, 240, .55), 0 0 24px -4px rgba(155, 63, 240, .55); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #6f7b92; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A two-way toggle that shows its state with a filled active tab rather than a text link.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(182, 166, 219, .055); } .ds-segment-btn { min-height: 38px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #93a1bb; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background .22s ease, color .22s ease; } .ds-segment-btn.is-active { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(150deg, #9b3ff0, #4a1c88); box-shadow: 0 0 24px -4px rgba(155, 63, 240, .55); }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Three-tab fixed mobile nav, TikTok/Quora-shaped — 44px hit targets, gold active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); background: rgba(22, 27, 38, .94); box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 rgba(182, 166, 219, .1), 0 -4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; height: 44px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #7f8ba4; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item.is-on { color: #ffe98a; } .ds-nav-item.is-on svg { filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(255, 210, 63, .45)); }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: A pill-track switch replacing a bordered checkbox for single-boolean choices.
components.css: .ds-switch-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 42px; height: 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .13); transition: background .22s ease; display: inline-block; } .ds-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ece7f7; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45); transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1); } .ds-switch-input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-switch-input:checked + .ds-switch { background: linear-gradient(110deg, #9b3ff0, #dc1413); } .ds-switch-input:checked + .ds-switch::after { transform: translateX(18px); }

components.name: Card / Tile
components.description: Borderless lobby tile — press feedback is a scale, not a background change.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; min-height: 92px; border: 0; padding: 13px 14px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(182, 166, 219, .055); color: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .12s ease; } .ds-tile:active { transform: scale(.985); } .ds-tile strong { color: #eef2f8; font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tile small { color: #93a1bb; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.35; }

narrative.overview:
StackChips' chrome — every screen except the felt itself — reads as a room lit by a single violet-and-gold sign in the dark: a deep violet-black ground, two soft out-of-focus glows bleeding in from opposite corners, and gold reserved for the one thing on a screen you're actually meant to press. It replaced an earlier "High Roller Arcade" chrome (blue-grey ground, a busier gold histogram accent) on 2026-08-27 when the app's own mark was redrawn; the mark's palette is now the chrome's palette, not the other way around.

The room is borderless by design. Older passes separated surfaces with 1px hairlines; the current system separates them with raised fill, real shadow, and space, and stands a border in for an --accent-edge inset ring plus --accent-glow when a surface needs to read as selected or focused. Purple is spent as a line and a glow, never a fill. Gold is spent once per screen, on the single primary action; everything else is quieter.
keyCharacteristics: Violet-black ground with two ambient corner glows (violet top-left, gold bottom-right), never a flat black or a re-tinted-per-surface wash.
Borderless chrome — separation is fill + shadow + space, not hairlines.
One saturated gold fill per screen, spent on the single primary action.
Purple is a line and a glow — accents, selected states, focus rings — never a background wash.
A serif display face (Georgia) for the wordmark and headlines, sans-serif (Inter) for everything functional.
The table's green felt and gold are a deliberately separate, untouched visual world.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Violet and gold come from the two ambient glows layered over the ground, never from re-tinting the ground itself per surface.

rules.name: The Single Fill Rule
rules.body: A saturated color fill is spent at most once per screen, on the one thing that's actually the primary action or the current selection.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Georgia appears only where something is being named or introduced — never on body copy, buttons, or anything functional.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Border Rule
rules.body: A selected or focused chrome surface gets an inset ring plus a colored shadow instead of a visible border.

rules.name: The Two Radii Rule
rules.body: Outside the table, everything is one of exactly two radii: --radius-card for a surface, --radius-control for anything interactive.

rules.name: Concentric Radii
rules.body: A control nested inside a padded track grows the outer radius by its own padding rather than shrinking the inner control below the shared value.

dos: Do treat purple as a line and a glow — reach for it on a border-color or box-shadow, not a background.
Do spend the one saturated gold fill on the actual primary action of the screen, and nothing else on that screen.
Do use --radius-control/--radius-card (both 8px) for every chrome surface.
Do use Georgia only for the wordmark, a page headline, or a tile's own title.
donts: Don't fill a whole chrome surface with --brand-purple/--neon-purple.
Don't add a visible 1px border to a chrome surface.
Don't reach for --brand-*/--neon-* tokens inside the table sheets, or --felt/table gold outside them.
Don't hand-write a new muted-gray literal — use --neon-muted/--neon-muted-2.
